question: Water is flowing through a cylindrical canal with an internal diameter of 7 m at the speed of 18 km/h. Find the volume of water flowing through the canal in 30 minutes. (take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Water is flowing through a cylindrical with an internal diameter of 7m 

And speed is 18 km/h 

**FORMULA USED:**

Volume of cylinder = pi r² h

Where, r = radius , h = height 

**CALCULATION:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49d123fd34dfbeacf749e9b236c540c329cec85b992029665be360768ebf2b78.png] 

Here, we have r = d/2 = 7/2 m 

Speed = height of the cylindrical pipe = 18kn/h = 18 × 5/18 m/s = 5 m/s [1km/h = 5/18 m/s] 

Volume of water flowing in cylindrical pipe = pi r² h 

⇒ 22/7 × (49/4) × 5 = 192.5 m³ 

⇒ In 1 sec volume of water flows = 192.5

⇒ In 30 × 60 sec volume of water flows = 192.5 × 30 × 60 = 346,500 m³ 

**Hence, volume of water flow in 30 min is 346,500 m³.**
